name: Regenerate subscription

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/update-subscription.yml"
      - "scripts/build_subscription.py"
      - "scripts/test_build_subscription.py"
      - "scripts/verify_lan_experimental.py"
      - "scripts/validate_openclash_module.py"
      - "lan-experimental-stats.json"
      - "openclash/**"
  schedule:
    # GitHub cron uses UTC: 06:00 and 18:00 UTC = 09:00 and 21:00 MSK.
    - cron: "0 6,18 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  regenerate:
    name: Regenerate and publish subscription
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Regenerate subscription files
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python scripts/build_subscription.py

      - name: Validate generated configs and OpenClash module
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check PyYAML==6.0.3
          python -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'
          test -s subscription-mobile.txt
          python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "scripts"); import build_subscription as b; text=open("subscription-mobile.txt", encoding="utf-8").read(); print(f"Happ mobile links: {b.validate_happ_subscription(text)}")'
          mkdir -p .tools/mihomo/home
          curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            https://api.github.com/repos/MetaCubeX/mihomo/releases/latest \
            -o .tools/mihomo/release.json
          asset_url="$(python -c 'import json,re,sys; assets=json.load(open(".tools/mihomo/release.json", encoding="utf-8")).get("assets", []); matches=[asset["browser_download_url"] for asset in assets if re.fullmatch(r"mihomo-linux-amd64-compatible-v.*\.gz", asset.get("name", ""))]; print(matches[0]) if len(matches) == 1 else sys.exit(f"expected exactly one Mihomo compatible asset, found {len(matches)}")')"
          test -n "$asset_url"
          curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors "$asset_url" -o .tools/mihomo/mihomo.gz
          gzip -dc .tools/mihomo/mihomo.gz > .tools/mihomo/mihomo
          chmod +x .tools/mihomo/mihomo
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t -f subscription-lan-global.yaml -d .tools/mihomo/home
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t -f subscription-lan-global-fast-check.yaml -d .tools/mihomo/home
          mkdir -p .tools/openclash-merged
          python scripts/validate_openclash_module.py \
            --module openclash/blacklist-routing.conf \
            --output-dir .tools/openclash-merged \
            subscription.yaml \
            subscription-ru.yaml \
            subscription-global.yaml \
            subscription-global-5k.yaml \
            subscription-lan-5k.yaml \
            subscription-lan-global.yaml \
            subscription-lan-global-fast-check.yaml \
            subscription-global-non-stable.yaml \
            subscription-bs-safe.yaml
          for config in .tools/openclash-merged/*.yaml; do
            .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t -f "$config" -d .tools/mihomo/home
          done
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo convert-ruleset domain yaml openclash/rules/custom-direct-domains.yaml .tools/mihomo/custom-direct-domains.mrs
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo convert-ruleset domain yaml openclash/rules/custom-proxy-domains.yaml .tools/mihomo/custom-proxy-domains.mrs
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo convert-ruleset ipcidr yaml openclash/rules/custom-direct-ip.yaml .tools/mihomo/custom-direct-ip.mrs
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo convert-ruleset ipcidr yaml openclash/rules/custom-proxy-ip.yaml .tools/mihomo/custom-proxy-ip.mrs
          server_count="$(awk '/^proxies:/{inside=1; next} /^proxy-groups:/{inside=0} inside && $0 == "  -"{count++} END{print count+0}' subscription-lan-global.yaml)"
          echo "LAN Global servers: $server_count"
          echo "### LAN Global and Fast Check" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Servers: $server_count" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Identical proxy list and order: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Fast Check AUTO: url-test, interval=600, tolerance=50, timeout=3000, max-failed-times=3, lazy=true" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Mihomo config tests: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- OpenClash merged configs: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Custom rule providers: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Build LAN Experimental candidate independently
        id: experimental_build
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 20
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python scripts/build_subscription.py --experimental-only

      - name: Validate LAN Experimental candidate independently
        id: experimental_validation
        if: steps.experimental_build.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          python scripts/verify_lan_experimental.py \
            --experimental .tools/lan-experimental-candidate/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml \
            --lan-global subscription-lan-global.yaml \
            --stats .tools/lan-experimental-candidate/lan-experimental-stats.json
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t \
            -f .tools/lan-experimental-candidate/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml \
            -d .tools/mihomo/home
          mkdir -p .tools/openclash-experimental
          python scripts/validate_openclash_module.py \
            --module openclash/blacklist-routing.conf \
            --output-dir .tools/openclash-experimental \
            .tools/lan-experimental-candidate/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t \
            -f .tools/openclash-experimental/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml \
            -d .tools/mihomo/home

      - name: Promote validated LAN Experimental candidate
        id: experimental_promotion
        if: >-
          steps.experimental_build.outcome == 'success' &&
          steps.experimental_validation.outcome == 'success'
        run: python scripts/build_subscription.py --promote-experimental

      - name: Reconcile retained LAN Experimental with current LAN Global
        if: steps.experimental_promotion.outcome != 'success'
        run: python scripts/build_subscription.py --reconcile-experimental

      - name: Validate saved LAN Experimental and publication metadata
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.experimental_promotion.outcome }}" = "success" ]; then
            experimental_status="new candidate promoted"
          else
            experimental_status="candidate rejected; retained set reconciled with current LAN Global"
          fi
          python scripts/verify_lan_experimental.py \
            --experimental subscription-lan-experimental.yaml \
            --lan-global subscription-lan-global.yaml \
            --stats lan-experimental-stats.json \
            --readme README.md
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t \
            -f subscription-lan-experimental.yaml \
            -d .tools/mihomo/home
          mkdir -p .tools/openclash-experimental-saved
          python scripts/validate_openclash_module.py \
            --module openclash/blacklist-routing.conf \
            --output-dir .tools/openclash-experimental-saved \
            subscription-lan-experimental.yaml
          .tools/mihomo/mihomo -t \
            -f .tools/openclash-experimental-saved/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml \
            -d .tools/mihomo/home
          experimental_count="$(python -c 'import yaml; data=yaml.safe_load(open("subscription-lan-experimental.yaml", encoding="utf-8")); print(len(data["proxies"]))')"
          auto_count="$(python -c 'import yaml; data=yaml.safe_load(open("subscription-lan-experimental.yaml", encoding="utf-8")); groups={group["name"]: group for group in data["proxy-groups"]}; print(len(groups["AUTO"]["proxies"]))')"
          echo "### LAN Experimental" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Status: $experimental_status" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Servers: $experimental_count" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- AUTO entries: $auto_count (all servers)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Intersections with validated LAN snapshot: 0" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- Mihomo config test: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "- README/statistics consistency: passed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Check checkout freshness
        id: freshness
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          local_head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          remote_head="$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
          if [ "$local_head" != "$remote_head" ]; then
            echo "origin/main moved from $local_head to $remote_head; skipping stale publish"
            echo "stale=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "stale=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Commit subscription when changed
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale != 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add README.md update-history.json lan-experimental-stats.json subscription.yaml subscription-ru.yaml subscription-global.yaml subscription-global-5k.yaml subscription-lan-5k.yaml subscription-lan-global.yaml subscription-lan-global-fast-check.yaml subscription-lan-experimental.yaml subscription-global-non-stable.yaml subscription-bs-safe.yaml subscription-mobile.txt
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "subscription files are unchanged"
          else
            git commit -m "Update subscription"
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              if git pull --rebase origin main && git push; then
                exit 0
              fi
              git rebase --abort || true
              echo "git push failed on attempt $attempt; retrying"
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
            done
            echo "git push failed after retries"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale != 'true'
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Prepare Pages artifact
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale != 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p public
          cp subscription.yaml public/subscription.yaml
          cp subscription-ru.yaml public/subscription-ru.yaml
          cp subscription-global.yaml public/subscription-global.yaml
          cp subscription-global-5k.yaml public/subscription-global-5k.yaml
          cp subscription-lan-5k.yaml public/subscription-lan-5k.yaml
          cp subscription-lan-global.yaml public/subscription-lan-global.yaml
          cp subscription-lan-global-fast-check.yaml public/subscription-lan-global-fast-check.yaml
          cp subscription-lan-experimental.yaml public/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml
          cp subscription-global-non-stable.yaml public/subscription-global-non-stable.yaml
          cp subscription-bs-safe.yaml public/subscription-bs-safe.yaml
          cp subscription-mobile.txt public/subscription-mobile.txt
          cp -R openclash public/openclash
          test -f public/openclash/blacklist-routing.conf
          test -f public/openclash/rules/custom-direct-domains.yaml
          test -f public/openclash/rules/custom-proxy-domains.yaml
          test -f public/openclash/rules/custom-direct-ip.yaml
          test -f public/openclash/rules/custom-proxy-ip.yaml
          test -s public/subscription-lan-global-fast-check.yaml
          test -s public/subscription-lan-experimental.yaml

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale != 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: public

      - name: Publish subscription to GitHub Pages
        if: steps.freshness.outputs.stale != 'true'
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

# ClawPanel — Setup Node (VPN Server)

## When to use
User wants to add a new VPN node that connects to an existing ClawPanel router.

## Prerequisites
- Node server with Debian/Ubuntu
- TLS certificate for the node's domain (Let's Encrypt, acme.sh, etc.)
- Panel already running with the node added in the UI

## Steps

### 1. Add node in panel first
In the ClawPanel UI → Nodes → Add Node:
- Name: internal ID like `NL1`, `DE1` (must match agent config)
- Address: node domain like `nl.clawvpn.lol`
- Flag: emoji like 🇳🇱
- Label: display name

### 2. Run setup on the node server
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pqhaz3925/clawpanel/main/setup-node.sh | bash
```

### 3. Or manual setup
```bash
# Download xray-hy
curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/xray-hy \
    https://github.com/pqhaz3925/clawpanel/releases/download/v2.1.0/xray-hy-linux-amd64
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/xray-hy

# Agent
mkdir -p /opt/claw-agent /etc/claw-agent /etc/claw-xray-hy
# Download agent.py to /opt/claw-agent/

# Agent env
cat > /etc/claw-agent/env << 'EOF'
PANEL_URL=https://panel.example.com
AGENT_SECRET=<from panel Settings>
NODE_NAME=NL1
XRAY_HY_BIN=/usr/local/bin/xray-hy
XRAY_HY_CFG=/etc/claw-xray-hy/config.json
XRAY_HY_SERVICE=claw-xray-hy
EOF

# Systemd services (claw-agent + claw-xray-hy)
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now claw-xray-hy claw-agent
```

## How it works
- Agent polls panel every 60s: `GET /agent/config/{NODE_NAME}`
- Receives full xray-hy JSON config with all active users
- Writes config atomically, restarts xray-hy if changed
- Sends heartbeat with traffic stats: `POST /agent/heartbeat`

## TLS certs
Node needs TLS certs for xray-hy (VLESS + HY2 inbounds). Common locations:
- acme.sh: `/root/.acme.sh/domain_ecc/fullchain.cer` + `.key`
- Marzban: `/var/lib/marzban/certs/fullchain.pem` + `key.pem`
- Let's Encrypt: `/etc/letsencrypt/live/domain/fullchain.pem` + `privkey.pem`

The panel's cert paths (in .env) are what get written into xray-hy config.

## Ports required
| Port | Protocol | Usage |
|------|----------|-------|
| 443 | TCP | VLESS XHTTP EXIT |
| 2052 | TCP | VLESS XHTTP DIRECT |
| 53 | UDP | HY2 XDNS |
| 9053 | UDP | HY2 XICMP |

## Troubleshooting
- Agent not connecting: check `journalctl -u claw-agent -f`
- xray-hy crash loop: likely wrong cert paths, check `journalctl -u claw-xray-hy -f`
- Node shows offline in panel: check heartbeat, agent secret mismatch
- Special chars in SSH password: use paramiko instead of sshpass
